verdict.rationale: The manual documents long-press commit actions to Delete Commit (rewriting the branch without it), Edit Message, and Squash a commit with its child. It also documents undoing unpushed commits and amending the latest commit. Reordering commits is never mentioned, and "edit" is only shown for commit messages, not commit contents. Missing for 10: commit reordering, editing the contents of older commits, independent or hands-on corroboration of the history-rewrite features.
